description: Search the MakeHybrid LinkedIn API catalogue (447 operations: 447 MakeHybrid API) and get back a compact table of plan, method, path, group and operation id, plus the total number of matches. Start here, then pass an id to makehybrid_describe_operation, then to makehybrid_read or makehybrid_write.

group.description: Exact group to filter by. Groups in this manifest: asana, billing, booking, brand, campaigns, chats, chatwoot, clickup, connect, discord, hubspot, inbox, inboxes, jira, line, linkedin, pages, posts, rooms, slack, users, webchat, webhooks, whatsapp, workspace, x.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50, max 200). The total match count is always reported, so narrow with query/group instead of raising this when the result is large.

plan.description: Restrict to one MakeHybrid plan: complete = MakeHybrid API (/linkedin). complete is the full LinkedIn surface, billed per seat (one LinkedIn account each) after a 30-day trial.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the operation id, path, group and summary. Examples: "search", "invitation", "chats/messages", "webhook".

name: makehybrid_list_operations
title: MakeHybrid: find an operation
